sections: Earnings Are Huge... But The Bar Is "Huger"

QQQ has broken out of its congestion above 727, but unlike the S&P, it has not yet reached a new all time high. Sustained higher lows above 727 followed by a break of 735.25 would give the S&P a stronger tailwind. A failure back into the range would put 716 to 714.35 in focus, while a deeper test of the 701.70 gap and 707 area would need a sharp reversal to remain constructive.
